Samira Rodriguez: Auditor just asked for a reproducible evidence package for the emergency KMS rotation we performed as part of the CVE mitigation. They want: a) exact KMS CloudTrail events (EnableKeyRotation/DisableKeyRotation/ScheduleKeyDeletion/GenerateDataKey/Decrypt) b) RBAC diffs showing service-account deprov c) approval records and signed attestation d) a reproducible manifest + sha256 and instructions. Scope: prod account 123456789012, window 2025-11-28 -> 2025-12-03. Can someone own this end-to-end?

Elliot Chen: I can take logs. Plan: run CloudTrail lookup + KMS control-plane events from CloudWatch Logs Insights and also export the S3 object with object-lock enabled. Ill include the CLI cmds and the raw JSON for each event. Example CLI Ill run:
`aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-11-28T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-12-03T23:59:59Z --query Events[*].CloudTrailEvent`
Ill also export a small CSV mapping eventId -> userIdentity.arn -> eventTime -> resources.

Devon Patel: Ill produce the RBAC change log from the IAM change store. Output format: CSV with columns (chg_id, actor, target_type, target_name, pre_bindings, post_bindings, ticket). Sample: `chg-20251129-42, infra:svc-update, serviceAccount:ingest-worker, pre:[ingest-reader], post:[], ticket:INC-9988`. Ill scrub UPNs/emails and replace with initials for privacy, but will include a redaction map in the bundle so auditor can reconcile.

Mira Gupta: For the narrative, use the IR excerpt: "Incident INC-9988 identified privilege escalation vector in dependency X; mitigation executed: service-account deprovision + KMS emergency rotation (rot-20251130-88). Approvals captured in ticket metadata. Post-rotation: automated verification checks (decrypt attempt by deprov account -> AccessDenied) and key policy audit." Ill draft the 2-paragraph risk->mitigation summary for the auditor.

Auditor - BDO: We need the chain: event -> principal -> key_arn -> timestamp. Also need a signed attestation from SecOps that the rotation was emergency, plus proof that after rotation the deprovisioned principal could not decrypt. The package must be reproducible by us; present exact commands and a reproducer script. Also provide the retention path and S3 immutability proof.

Elliot Chen: Will include an artifacts directory layout in the manifest: `cloudtrail/`, `kms_logs/`, `iam_diffs/`, `tickets/`, `manifests/`, `scripts/`. Ill add a small shell script `replay_check.sh` that re-runs the CloudTrail lookup (read-only) and validates the sha256 of the bundle. For S3 immutability: Ill enable Object Lock (GOVERNANCE mode) on the uploaded tar and include the put-object response with `x-amz-object-lock-mode` and `x-amz-object-lock-retain-until-date`.

Devon Patel: For access proofI will run an impersonation check from a controlled run and capture that the `deprov-svc-role` fails decrypt. Command Ill run (for audit):
`aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deprov-svc-role --role-session-name audit-check`
Then using the temporary creds attempt a decrypt; result should be AccessDenied; include the exact CloudTrail event JSON and the requestParameters.keyId.

evidence-bot: snapshot-job started (id: snap-1746601234). Target: s3://redwood-evidence/prod/snap-1746601234.tar.gz.

Mira Gupta: Note on redactions: we will redact internal IPs and personal emails. We will not redact principal ARNs or key ARNs. Redaction map will be in `tickets/redactions.md`. Auditor should be able to map redacted identifiers via the map.

Elliot Chen: Export done: uploaded `snap-1746601234.tar.gz` (1.05GB) to s3://redwood-evidence/prod/ with object lock. sha256: f5d2b4... (manifest/manifests/sha256.txt). Ive also included `scripts/replay_check.sh` and `commands.log` showing exact CLI outputs and timestamps.

Auditor - BDO: Received. Quick asks: 1) show who signed the approval and timestamp for rot-20251130-88 2) provide the exact keystore/key policy snapshots pre and post rotation 3) confirm the deprovisioned principal's AttemptTime and CloudTrail eventId for the failed decrypt.

Samira Rodriguez: Approval metadata: ticket INC-9988 shows approvals by "Mira Gupta (SecOps)" at 2025-11-30T02:45:12Z and "Samira Rodriguez (CISO)" at 2025-11-30T02:56:03Z. Ill attach the signed attestation (pdf) and put a note in the cover letter. Keystore policy snapshot is in `kms_logs/key-policy-before.json` and `kms_logs/key-policy-after.json` in the bundle.

Devon Patel: Failed decrypt proof: CloudTrail eventId `d8f3a1b2-...` at 2025-12-01T05:03:17Z shows `AccessDenied` for principal `arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/deprov-svc-role`. Raw event in `cloudtrail/errors/d8f3a1b2.json`.

Auditor - BDO: Great. Last things: can you produce a 1-page control matrix mapping each artifact to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9 clauses? Also please note any deviations or exceptions (none expected). Once provided we will schedule a remote verification session where we run the `replay_check.sh` against your tar (read-only).

Samira Rodriguez: Will do. Ill create `control_matrix.md` and a short cover letter. Well also include a timestamped SHA256 signed by SecOps lead (PGP signature). Expect final bundle + docs in this thread by EOD.

evidence-bot: snapshot-job snap-1746601234 completed: 1.05GB uploaded, manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/prod/snap-1746601234/manifest.json (signed).
